== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ホス：防衛線</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light Side''' — <span lang="ja">自分のエコー基地兵員はここでは配備コスト－１。ここを支配しているなら、フォース消耗に＋１。</span>

'''Dark Side''' — <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、フォース消耗に＋１。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. Your Echo Base Troopers may deploy here for 1 less. If you control this site, Force drain plus 1. Dark Side. If you control this site, Force drain plus 1.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Force icon counts and both side effects match the English original. Japanese uses フォース消耗 for Force drain and エコー基地兵員 for Echo Base Troopers.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-hothdefensiveperimeter.gif|Original English face]], [[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)]].</ref>
